name: ACS712
title: Hall-effect current sensor, ±5/20/30 A, analog
titleRu: Датчик тока на эффекте Холла, ±5/20/30 А, аналоговый

pins.name: OUT
pins.desc: VCC/2 at 0 A, 185/100/66 mV per A

notes: Needs 5 V. OUT swings up to 5 V: on a 3.3 V board use a divider and rescale the zero point.
The load current flows through IP+ / IP- (screw terminal), isolated from the logic side.
